items.exampleEn: An improbable story about a talking dog went around the school.
items.exampleZh: 一個關於會說話的狗的離奇故事在學校裡傳開了。

items.exampleEn: Children learn to generalize grammar rules from the words they hear.
items.exampleZh: 孩子會從聽到的字詞中歸納出文法規則。

items.exampleEn: Saying the line was a mile long is an exaggeration.
items.exampleZh: 說隊伍排了一英里長，太誇張了。

items.exampleEn: The claims in the article were refuted by the company.
items.exampleZh: 文章裡的說法遭到那家公司駁斥。

items.exampleEn: He knowingly sold a broken phone to a customer.
items.exampleZh: 他明知手機是壞的，還是賣給了客人。

items.exampleEn: The speech lacked coherence; the ideas jumped around.
items.exampleZh: 那場演講缺乏條理，想法跳來跳去。

items.exampleEn: My father is an optimist who always expects the best.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸是個樂觀的人，總是往最好的方向想。

items.exampleEn: "It's raining cats and dogs" is a figurative expression.
items.exampleZh: 「下貓下狗」是一種比喻的說法，意思是雨下得很大。

items.sentenceEn: The film had beautiful pictures but little coherence in its story.
items.sentenceZh: 那部電影畫面很美，但故事沒什麼連貫性。

items.audioEn: When I said my bag weighs a ton, I was being figurative.
items.audioZh: 我說我的包包重一噸，那只是比喻。
items.questionZh: 說話者的包包實際上怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: Try not to generalize about a city after one short visit.
items.sentenceZh: 別只去過一次，就對一座城市下定論。

items.sentenceEn: Poets often use figurative language to describe love.
items.sentenceZh: 詩人常用比喻的語言來描寫愛情。

items.stemEn: Even after losing ten games in a row, the coach remained an ____ about the season.
items.stemZh: 即使連輸十場，教練對這一季仍然很樂觀。

items.stemEn: My brother tried to ____ my point, but he had no facts.
items.stemZh: 我哥哥想反駁我的論點，但他拿不出任何事實。

items.passageEn: At a family dinner last week, my uncle said that young people never read books anymore. My cousin, who is an optimist and a big reader, said that was an exaggeration. "You can't generalize from one or two teenagers," she told him. She then refuted his point with numbers from the library: more young people borrowed books this year than last year. My uncle smiled knowingly and admitted that it was just a harmless way to start a lively conversation. He also said it was improbable that he could ever win an argument against her.
items.passageZh: 上週家庭聚餐時，我舅舅說年輕人現在都不讀書了。我表妹是個樂觀又愛讀書的人，她說這太誇張了。「你不能從一兩個青少年就推論所有人。」她對舅舅說。接著，她用圖書館的數字反駁了他的說法：今年借書的年輕人比去年還多。舅舅會意地笑了笑，承認那只是開啟熱鬧話題的無害方式。他還說，反正他也不太可能辯得贏她。

questions.questionZh: 表妹怎麼反駁舅舅的說法？
options: 說她自己一年讀了一百本書
拿出圖書館的借書數字
他真的覺得年輕人不讀書
他剛看完一篇新聞報導

items.promptZh: 他準時到的可能性不大。
referenceEn: It is improbable that he will arrive on time.
It's improbable that he will be on time.
rubricZh: improbable 的用法，例如 It is improbable that… 等
時態合理（例如 will arrive、will be 等）

items.promptZh: 他的故事裡有很多誇張的地方。
referenceEn: There is a lot of exaggeration in his story.
His story is full of exaggeration.
rubricZh: exaggeration 當名詞（例如 a lot of exaggeration、full of exaggeration 等）
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）
